1	// Room "P1 hall" (interior designer's part): the Mission entrance hall, x22..25 z14..20, feet at y2, floor layer y1.
2	// Focal piece: a spruce-stair bench on the back wall (z20), facing the front door. A fence-post table with a potted
3	// poppy stands on the east wall beside the coat rack; lanterns hang from the upper floor's block above (y5).
4	// The stair flight at x22 z15..18 is the stair joiner's and is never written here.
5	import { layers, B } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
6	import { coatRack } from "../vocab.mjs";
7	
8	export function build(g) {
9	  // feet level (y2): bench seats at x22..23 z20 (back to the south wall), table post at x25 z17
10	  layers(g, [22, 2, 14], {
11	    S: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "south", half: "bottom" }],
12	    F: "spruce_fence",
13	  }, [
14	    ["....",
15	     "....",
16	     "....",
17	     "...F",
18	     "....",
19	     "....",
20	     "SS.."],
21	  ]);
22	
23	  // table top: a top slab on the fence post at y3 (its top face at y4)
24	  layers(g, [22, 3, 14], {
25	    T: ["spruce_slab", { type: "top" }],
26	  }, [
27	    ["....",
28	     "....",
29	     "....",
30	     "...T",
31	     "....",
32	     "....",
33	     "...."],
34	  ]);
35	
36	  // y4: a potted poppy on the table, and two lanterns hung from the upper floor (y5) over the lane
37	  layers(g, [22, 4, 14], {
38	    P: "potted_poppy",
39	    L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
40	  }, [
41	    ["....",
42	     "....",
43	     ".L..",
44	     "...P",
45	     "....",
46	     ".L..",
47	     "...."],
48	  ]);
49	
50	  // coat rack by the front door, on the east side of the entry (x25 z14), facing into the room
51	  coatRack(g, { x: 25, y: 2, z: 14, facing: "west", color: "brown", wood: "spruce" });
52	}
53

I'll remove the refused writes, keep the layout in the header so it can come back, and check the result.
